description:
**About the Company** 




  





 I
 **ndustry: Doors / Building Materials / Interior / Fit\-Out Projects** 




  





**About the Role** 




  





 Project Manager – Installation \& Site Projects
 


* **Location: Kochi, Kerala**
* **Experience: 5 –10 Years**
* **Qualification: B. Tech/ Diploma in Civil / Mechanical Engineering**



  





 We are looking for an experienced Project Manager – Installation \& Projects to lead and manage door installation projects from planning through completion. The role will be responsible for site execution, manpower and resource management, quality, cost control, customer coordination, and post\-installation service. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in door installation, interior projects, fit\-outs, modular projects, building materials, or similar site\-based project execution.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





*Project Planning \& Execution* 




  




* Plan and execute door installation projects within agreed timelines and budgets.
* Coordinate with Sales, Production, CSD, Quality, customers, contractors, and site teams for smooth project execution.
* Monitor project progress and proactively resolve execution\-related challenge



  





*Site \& Installation Management* 



* Plan and allocate installation manpower across multiple project sites.
* Supervise site activities and ensure adherence to timelines, quality standards, and company SOPs.
* Ensure proper handling, storage, and accountability of doors, jambs, hardware, installation kits, keys, and other materials at site.
* Plan and oversee accurate measurement of door cases across projects.
* Review and validate site measurements before releasing details for production.
* Ensure proper project handover upon completion.



  





*Cost \& Resource Management* 




  




* Monitor installation and project\-related costs against approved budgets.
* Optimize manpower, materials, tools, and other resources.
* Minimize material wastage, damage, rework, and other avoidable costs.



  





*Quality Management* 




  




* Ensure installations comply with company standards, approved specifications, drawings, and customer requirements.
* Conduct regular site inspections and quality checks.
* Identify deviations and ensure timely corrective action.
* Minimize rework and ensure quality completion before handover.



  





*Team Management* 




  




* Lead and supervise Site Supervisors and installation teams.
* Allocate work effectively and monitor productivity and performance.
* Coach and train team members to improve installation quality and efficiency.



  





*Customer \& Post\-Sales Management* 




  




* Act as a key point of contact for customers during project execution.
* Handle customer queries, concerns, and escalations professionally.
* Coordinate resolution of post\-installation complaints within defined timelines.
* Analyze recurring complaints and recommend preventive actions.
* Build strong customer relationships through timely communication and effective issue resolution.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* B.Tech in Civil or Mechanical Engineering is mandatory.
* Qualification: B. Tech/ Diploma in Civil / Mechanical Engineering



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* 5–10 years of relevant experience in project management, installation, site execution, interiors, fit\-outs, modular projects, doors, or building materials.
* Hands\-on experience in managing multiple project sites and installation teams.
* Good understanding of site measurements, drawings, specifications, and installation processes.
* Strong manpower, resource, and cost management skills.
* Good customer handling and problem\-solving abilities.
* Willingness to travel to project sites as required.



  





 Key Skills: Project Management \| Door Installation \| Site Execution \| Manpower Management \| Cost Control \| Quality Management \| Customer Handling \| Post\-Sales Service \| Team Leadership

description:

 Position: Program Manager

**Executive Summary**
 The Program Manager will lead the planning, coordination, and execution of Elance Learning’s student engagement and events agenda, ensuring that every initiative strengthens student experience, campus culture, and organisational outcomes. This role is accountable for building a structured monthly and quarterly engagement calendar, aligning programmes with academic priorities, and coordinating with internal and external stakeholders for seamless execution. The successful candidate will bring strong ownership, execution discipline, creativity, and stakeholder\-management capability to convert ideas into high\-impact student programmes that enhance participation, satisfaction, and institutional engagement.
   

  

**Strategic Responsibilities**
* Design and manage a structured student engagement calendar aligned with academic, campus, and organisational priorities.
* Plan and execute events, workshops, competitions, celebrations, awareness programmes, and student\-development initiatives.
* Develop new engagement formats based on student needs, institutional goals, and emerging learning trends.
* Coordinate with Academic, Campus, Marketing, Operations, and other teams to ensure integrated event execution.
* Prepare event plans, timelines, budgets, resource requirements, execution checklists, and post\-event review reports.
* Own end\-to\-end programme delivery from concept development and planning to execution, feedback collection, and outcome analysis.
* Coordinate with external vendors, speakers, trainers, partners, and other stakeholders wherever required.
* Drive student participation through clear communication, timely coordination, and consistent follow\-up.
* Monitor programme execution across campuses and ensure delivery within approved timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
* Maintain documentation including calendars, reports, photographs, participation records, feedback summaries, and management updates. Ideal Candidate Profile
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Management, Education, Event Management, or a related discipline.
* Relevant experience in student engagement, programme management, event management, academic operations, or campus activities.
* Strong planning, coordination, project management, and execution skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication with the ability to manage diverse stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple programmes independently while ensuring timely follow\-up and quality delivery.
* Creative, proactive, and outcome\-oriented approach to student engagement.
* Strong problem\-solving ability, ownership mindset, and accountability for deliverables.
* Ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams, external partners, and campus stakeholders.
* Willingness to travel across campuses or locations, based on programme requirements.


**Key Success Measures**
* Quality, structure, and consistency of the student engagement calendar.
* Number, relevance, and impact of programmes and events conducted.
* Student participation, engagement, feedback, and satisfaction levels.
* Timely execution of planned activities within approved standards and budgets.
* Effectiveness of cross\-functional coordination and stakeholder communication.
* Innovation introduced in student engagement and campus experience initiatives.
* Quality of post\-event reporting, documentation, and management updates.


**Core Competencies**
*Programme Management \| Student Engagement Strategy \| Event Execution \| Stakeholder Management \| Cross\-Functional Coordination \| Planning \& Governance \| Communication \| Ownership \| Innovation \| Problem Solving*

 Elance Learning is a growing education and learning organisation committed to delivering quality academic and career\-oriented learning experiences. The organisation focuses on academic excellence, student development, and outcome\-driven learning through an engaging and supportive student ecosystem. This role is critical to strengthening the student experience at Elance Learning by building a vibrant programme culture, improving engagement touchpoints, and ensuring that campus initiatives are executed with consistency, creativity, and measurable impact.

title: Incident & Change Management Coordinator
description:
Dodge Construction Network (Dodge) is looking for a detail\-oriented, process\-driven professional to build out and mature our Incident Management and Change Management functions. These functions currently exist but lack formal structure\-this role will own the transformation from ad hoc handling to a disciplined, auditable, well\-governed practice. You'll design and implement the processes, approval workflows, and reporting that give engineering, IT, and leadership confidence that incidents are resolved consistently and changes are reviewed, approved, and tracked before they hit production. This is a hands\-on process\-and\-tooling role, not just a policy\-writing one. You'll be expected to build the actual workflows, forms, and automations inside our Atlassian ecosystem (Jira, Confluence, and related apps) that make the new processes stick.
   

  

 This is a full\-time position and reports directly to the VP, IT Infrastructure and Operations.
   

  

***Preferred Location***
 Qualified candidates should be based in or near Kochi and able to work from our Kochi office as part of a hybrid schedule.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
**Incident Management**
* Formalize incident management processes: severity classification, escalation paths, communication protocols, and resolution SLAs
* Own the incident lifecycle in Jira Service Management (or Jira), from detection/logging through resolution and closure
* Drive post\-incident reviews (blameless retrospectives / RCAs), ensure action items are tracked and closed, and report on recurring themes
* Build dashboards and recurring reports on incident volume, MTTR, severity trends, and SLA compliance for leadership visibility


**Change Management**
* Design and implement a formal Change Management process, including change categorization (standard/normal/emergency), risk assessment, and CAB (Change Advisory Board) review cadence
* Build structured Jira workflows and forms to capture change requests, required approvals, rollback plans, and post\-implementation review
* Partner with engineering, infrastructure, and application teams (AWS, M365, Atlassian, and internal platforms) to ensure changes are properly vetted before deployment
* Track change success/failure rates and use data to continuously refine the process


**Tooling, Automation \& Governance**
* Configure and maintain Jira workflows, schemes, automation rules, and Jira Service Management request forms to support both processes end\-to\-end
* Use Atlassian automation (Jira Automation, Confluence integrations, forms) to reduce manual steps\-auto\-routing, approval reminders, SLA breach alerts, ticket linking, etc.
* Maintain Confluence documentation: runbooks, process guides, RACI charts, and CAB meeting notes
* Establish approval workflows and audit trails that satisfy internal governance and any relevant compliance requirements
* Identify opportunities to integrate Incident/Change data with other systems (e.g., monitoring/alerting tools, CMDB\-type asset tracking) as the practice matures


**Cross\-Functional Coordination**
* Act as the process owner and point of contact across engineering, infrastructure, and vendor/contractor teams for all things incident and change related
* Facilitate CAB meetings and post\-incident reviews, keeping them efficient and action\-oriented
* Train and onboard teams on new processes, driving adoption without becoming a bottleneck


***Education Requirement***
 Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent education and work experience.
   

  

**Required Experience, Knowledge And Skills**
* 3\+ years of experience in Incident Management, Change Management, IT Service Management (ITSM), or a Project/Program Management role with process\-ownership responsibility
* Hands\-on experience administering Atlassian products\-Jira and/or Jira Service Management required; Confluence experience strongly preferred
* Demonstrated experience building Jira workflows, automation rules, and forms (Jira Service Management request forms or similar) \- this is not just "used Jira," but "configured Jira."
* Strong understanding of ITIL\-aligned incident and change management concepts (formal ITIL certification is a plus, not required)
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to build structure from ambiguity\-you'll be creating a lot of this from scratch
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable facilitating meetings with technical and non\-technical stakeholders, including leadership
* Data\-oriented mindset\-comfortable building reports/dashboards to show process health and drive continuous improvement
* Experience working in a technical environment (cloud infrastructure, SaaS, or software engineering organization) is a strong plus, even if you're not an engineer yourself


**Preferred Experience, Knowledge And Skills**
* ITIL v3/v4 Foundation certification
* Experience with Jira Service Management's Change and Incident\-specific templates/features
* Familiarity with AWS or Microsoft 365 environments (you won't need to administer them but understanding what a "change" looks like in these environments helps)
* Experience supporting SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar compliance frameworks where change/incident records are auditable evidence


**About Dodge Construction Network**
 Dodge Construction Network exists to deliver the comprehensive data and connections the construction industry needs to build thriving communities. Our legacy is deeply rooted in empowering our customers with transformative insights, igniting their journey towards unparalleled business expansion and success. We serve decision\-makers who seek reliable growth and who value relationships built on trust and quality. By combining our proprietary data with cutting\-edge software, we deliver to our customers the essential intelligence needed to excel within their respective landscapes. We propel the construction industry forward by transforming data into tangible guidance, driving unparalleled advancement.
   

  

 Dodge is the catalyst for modern construction.

title: Fiber Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Yastel Networks Pvt Ltd is a growing telecommunications company headquartered in Bangalore, India, focused on delivering reliable network infrastructure and connectivity solutions. The organization works with modern fiber and network technologies to support high\-performance communication services for a diverse range of clients. Team members collaborate across engineering, operations, and project functions to build and maintain robust telecom networks. The company emphasizes practical innovation, safety, and service quality, creating opportunities for professionals to develop their technical skills in a dynamic environment.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Fiber Engineer role is a full\-time hybrid position based in Kochi, with a mix of on\-site work and some work\-from\-home flexibility. The Fiber Engineer will plan, design, and implement fiber\-optic networks, including route planning, splicing plans, and documentation for outside plant infrastructure. Responsibilities include coordinating site surveys, supervising fiber installation and testing, resolving network issues, and ensuring compliance with technical standards and safety guidelines. * Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work safely on\-site and independently when remote.
* Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related technical field is preferred.

title: Oracle EBS SCM Techno-Functional Consultant
description:

* Collaborate closely with business users, planners, and fulfillment teams to provide proactive support and process continuity.
* Participate in issue triage bridges, identify workarounds, and validate business\-impacting fixes.

**Technical Support**

* Proficiency in PL/SQL, Oracle Reports, Forms, BI Publisher, and Workflow Builder.

* Comfortable working in SOX\-compliant environments with strict access control and audit requirements.

 **Senior Site Coordinator**
